items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-09-18
items.q: That's not one of the words of Ron Hill.

ctx.x: Well, I was sitting with people that knew about music and some of them anyway, certainly, and they appreciated a good lead on it, a good MC, and that's part of what Buddy Tateau. Back to the words and the way they're used here in New Orleans. If you say something is terrible in Texas, what does that mean?
It means it's bad. That's not one of the words of Ron Hill. Terrible is a nationally used word.

Yeah, but I mean, people in New Orleans sometimes will say, oh, he's a terrible trumpet player. They mean he's great. Right. Oh, he's a bad trumpet player. Yeah, well, that's the slang. Yeah, do they use that in Texas? They say that same thing, don't you? Yeah, sure they do. I thought that was true.
